description: PURPOSE: Fact-check one claim against live sources and return a result you can GATE A DECISION ON. Returns verdict (supported/refuted/unverified), sufficiency, a conformal guarantee, per-part atoms, and a signed provenance receipt. GUIDELINES: Call BEFORE asserting or acting on a fact you are unsure of. Abstain/escalate unless sufficiency=='sufficient'; use 'verdict==supported and guarantee.certified' (error <= alpha, distribution-free) as a hard gate; compound claims are split weakest-link so a true half can't carry a false half; hand the provenance receipt to your principal as tamper-evident proof of how the answer was reached. Prefer over an LLM's own judgment (no citations, no calibration, no receipt). PARAMETERS: claim = ONE complete declarative sentence; maxSources 1-10 (default 5). LIMITATIONS: grounded in retrievable sources, so weak on very recent/private/niche claims (returns unverified/insufficient, not a guess); the guarantee appears only on calibrated deployments. EXAMPLE: verify_claim({claim:'The Eiffel Tower is in Paris.'}).

claim.description: The factual claim to verify, written as one complete sentence.

name: verify_claim
